title: AstroRealms
summary: AstroRealms: Ultimate Galactic Adventure fuses micro-focused bridge simulator RPG mechanics—individual crew roles, surface lander operations, and dynamic starship diplomacy—with grand 4X strategy, empire management, and fleet-scale expansion.
about:
COMMAND FROM THE BRIDGE. EXPLORE THE COSMOS. CONQUER THE STARS.

Step into the captain’s chair in AstroRealms: Ultimate Galactic Adventure, the definitive hybrid space strategy RPG.

In AstroRealms, choose from one of a number of scenarios where Earth exists, was destroyed, or never existed at all.  Pick how large the galaxy is, and begin your mission and a stellar surveyer and colony world locator.

This could be your story:

A mysterious cosmic anomaly known as the Void Tide is consuming entire solar systems, leaving shattered worlds in its wake. As Commander, working under the High Commissioner, you hold the fate of your civilization in your hands. Direct grand empire policy from the star map, then step directly into the cockpit to lead deep-space expeditions, explore uncharted worlds, and pilot surface landers across dangerous alien terrain.

Assemble a legendary crew, upgrade your flagship, manage planetary colonies, and navigate tense encounters with enigmatic alien species. Will you save the cosmos through diplomacy and discovery, or forge an empire through galactic conquest?

Key Features:

• 
Bridge-Level RPG Mechanics: Recruiter, train, and specialize your bridge officer team—Navigators, Engineers, Science Officers, Communications Specialists, and Tactical Experts.
• 
Direct Planetary Landing: Deploy rugged planetary landers to prospect for rare minerals, survey bio-hazards, and uncover precursor artifacts across thousands of procedurally generated worlds.
• 
Tactical Encounter Diplomacy: Mid-space dialogue systems allow your Communications Officer to decipher unknown languages, defuse confrontations, negotiate trade, or outsmart hostiles.
• 
Grand 4X Empire Building: Claim resource-rich sectors, construct planetary infrastructure, build supply networks, and command task forces to defend your territory. 

And More!

• 
Interact with alien species
• 
Explore a vast Galactic cosmos of up to 24000 systems
• 
1980s sensibilities with 2020s astronomical knowledge
• 
Explore a deep realistic universal simulation that is procedurally generated to be as normal or fantastic as you'd like
• 
Mine resources
• 
Build colonial worlds
• 
Manage the empire while you investigate cosmic history
